title: Objective Definition
governance_note: State what the objective includes, excludes, minimizes, or maximizes.

title: Constraint Definition
governance_note: Document equality, inequality, units, boundary meaning, and hidden assumptions.

title: Lagrange Multiplier
governance_note: Interpret as local and unit-dependent; do not treat as a universal value.

title: Active Boundary
governance_note: Flag active, inactive, violated, and near-active constraints.

title: Shadow Value
governance_note: Shadow values require objective, constraint, scaling, and local-validity documentation.
